name: mdvsp-ts-arc-flow-time-expanded
description: Arc-flow (multi-commodity, one commodity per depot) formulation of the Multi-Depot Vehicle Scheduling Problem with Trip Shifting on a fully time-expanded network. Each depot has its own copy of the time-space graph; integer arc-flow variables route vehicles from a source depot node to a sink depot node. Trip shifting is modelled implicitly: each timetabled trip is expanded into multiple parallel trip arcs, one per admissible departure-time deviation in [-maxDeviation, +maxDeviation] (TimeSpaceGraph.initNodes/addTripArcs), and a cover constraint forces exactly one of these copies (across all depots) to be used. Objective minimizes total cost = fixed cost per vehicle (pull-in/pull-out arcs) + variable deadheading cost. This is the model solved both by the MIP baseline (SolverMIP on the full network) and, on iteratively refined sparser networks, by the DDD algorithm; the formulation is identical, only the underlying TimeSpaceGraph differs.

indices.name: T
indices.description: set of timetabled trips that must be covered

indices.name: G_d_V_d_A_d
indices.description: per-depot time-space network: timed nodes V_d (station x time) and timed arcs A_d

indices.name: A_d
indices.description: timed arcs for depot d (trip, deadhead, waiting, pull-in, pull-out arcs)

indices.name: A_trip_d
indices.description: subset of A_d that are trip arcs (type==1); each is a (trip, departure-deviation) copy

indices.name: arcs_t
indices.description: all trip arcs (over all depots) that represent some departure-time copy of trip t

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: cost of using arc a in depot layer d: 0 for trip/waiting arcs, VARIABLE_COST*travelTime for deadhead arcs, FIXED_COST+VARIABLE_COST*travelTime for pull-in/pull-out arcs [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: FIXED_COST
parameters.description: fixed cost charged on each pull-in and pull-out arc (so 2*FIXED_COST = 1000 per vehicle) [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: VARIABLE_COST
parameters.description: variable cost per minute of driving (deadhead / pull travel time) [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: maxDeviation
parameters.description: maximum allowed forward/backward shift (in minutes) of a trip's departure time; controls how many parallel trip-arc copies exist per trip [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: tau_ij
parameters.description: travel (deadhead/pull) time between locations i and j, from the instance travel-time matrix [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: maxVehicles
parameters.description: optional cap on number of vehicles dispatched (total depot outflow); only enforced when nonzero [domain Z_>=0]

variables.name: x
variables.description: flow on arc a in the time-space network of depot d (number of vehicles of depot d using arc a)

constraints.name: flow_conservation
constraints.description: at every non-depot timed node, inflow equals outflow in each depot layer (vehicles are conserved; depot source/sink nodes are unconstrained so they emit/absorb the fleet) [capture: sum over a widened to family A_trip_d; source binder: 'a \\in in(n)'; sum over a widened to family A_trip_d; source binder: 'a \\in out(n)']

constraints.name: trip_cover
constraints.description: each timetabled trip is served exactly once, by exactly one depot and exactly one of its admissible departure-time (shift) copies [capture: sum condition not representable: 'trip(a)=t']

constraints.name: depot_outflow_cap
constraints.description: optional: total number of vehicles leaving the depots at time 0 is fixed to maxVehicles [capture: sum over a widened to family A_trip_d; source binder: 'a \\in out(\\mathrm{depot}_d, t=0)']

objective.name: objective
objective.description: minimize total vehicle-scheduling cost = fixed cost per dispatched vehicle (on pull-in/pull-out arcs) plus variable deadheading/pull travel cost summed over all depot layers and arcs
